posts.t: It was giveaway galore for the Habs in the first; they committed 10 to the Mammoth's 5 and looked really frazzled early on. The captain made his presence felt with the first goal, and the momentum shifted. Shots 8-5 MTL, Utah hasn't had one since the 11th minute  #GoHabsGo
